denominator_kind: Primary-source textual contexts, including joint authorship and attributed embedded quotations; not a count of exclusively Graeber-spoken words.
method: Body ranges inherit full-read coverage. AN keeps DG turns; UT keeps listed essays and DG turns, excluding editorial opening and recognized UR/BJ reprints. Tags/headings are omitted; remaining lines use whitespace word counts.
adaptation: Maps the legacy words_firsthand parameter to this explicitly scoped primary-source pool. Targets are planning calculations, not formal research admission. A 0-to-400 mass-term sensitivity is also reported.
